name: Wavelet Transform
definition: Defined by Monet Morlet [18] to avoid the fixed resolution limit of windowed Fourier transforms. It decomposes the signal into a family of functions, which are the translation and dilation of unique ip{x).
summary: The Wavelet Transform decomposes signals into dilated and translated basis functions, providing sparse, variable-resolution analysis with local support that eliminates the block-based processing required by global transforms like DCT.
